scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of all stated quantifiers and separate finite diagnostic. The regular extremal value uses classical sine concavity; the parity-resolved nonsmooth stability statement is the assessed addition.
scientific_limitations: Planar centrally symmetric strictly convex equilateral polygons only; first variation local to regular polygon; one-sided derivative; no unrestricted equilateral maximum or global quadratic stability claim; priority remains provisional pending independent review.
title: Parity-split infinitesimal width rigidity of centrally symmetric equilateral polygons
